behaviors.description: Tracked continuous water appearances retain refraction chromatic IOR, depth absorption, micro waves/ripples, Fresnel sky and actual reflected-scene optics, river streaks and trough presentation. The surface mesh retains 1.5-metre central sampling and adds six-metre outer sampling to 240 metres per chart axis. Beyond 48 metres, generated river/lake presentation may use the analytic drainage bed when accepted triangle coverage is absent; this display-only approximation never establishes physics occupancy. Native helpers borrow existing devices and immutable opaque/reflection inputs, with a private depth/layer and composite; they never create a new window/device/swapchain. Clear presentation retains neutral reflection fallback colors and actual sky colors, with zero murkiness by default. The water layer contains a complete transmitted-scene/Fresnel-reflection result and composites at full coverage; historical Cardinal91 low material alpha is not applied again to that already-composed result. Sky reflections use the actual sky palette without a fixed blue wash. Time-of-day brightness dims the neutral fallback, never the sky blend weight, so darkness cannot select a white reflection.
behaviors.selection: The configured water application is active; pause retains frozen persistent appearance and resumes under a new tracked water event.

checks.procedure: Verify shader attribute/uniform layout on GL/ES, Vulkan and WebGPU independently. Render actual opaque refraction and reflected-camera clipped scene, with stable geometric depth vs optical normal; inspect occlusion, overlapping water, ripple wakes, submerged/dry views, river streaks, cover handling, resizing and native cleanup. Readback/rendered proof is required; CPU optics/reference or compilation alone is not presentation verification. Preserve upstream global grading/Panini/audio responsibilities.
